facts.fact: The e-Vital Togo project, started August 2026, pilots in four communes (Golfe 3, Agoe-Nyive 1, Kozah 1, Bassar 1) entry of births and deaths in health facilities and electronic transmission to civil-status services, per the Ministry of Health project lead.

systems.owner: Ministry of Health (Direction du systeme national d'information sanitaire), funded by Vital Strategies
systems.tiers: health facilities; municipal civil-status services; INSEED
